title: 第4章：大巴、手枪与八分钟的生死倒计时！
slug: 丧尸爆发我的房车能无限升级
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林昊把防暴叉从变异丧尸的后颈里拔出来。

叉齿上挂着一缕灰黑色的筋膜，腥气冲鼻子。

他退了两步，左肋火辣辣地抽了一下，呼吸都不敢往深了喘。

系统面板上【外挂储物模块】的安装提示闪了两下就消失了。

储物空间的数字从5跳到8.2，多出三个立方，够用。

他一瘸一拐回到超市货架前，把剩下的罐头整箱往车厢搬。

午餐肉、黄桃、压缩饼干、矿泉水。跑一趟搬一箱，跑一趟搬一箱。

中途在过道里碰上两只从后厨方向摸过来的丧尸，防暴叉一只一只叉死。

又在二楼楼梯间堵死两只，四颗灰色晶核收进口袋。

搬完最后一箱水，两条胳膊抖得拧不动瓶盖。

【物资清点完成——食物储备：约14天/饮用水储备：约10天】

【近战武器：防暴叉×1，橡胶警棍×1，铁撬棍×1】

【远程武器：猎弩×1（弩箭剩余12支）】

短期内饿不死渴不死。

林昊靠在车厢壁上，翻出急救箱。碘伏、纱布、医用胶带，没有止痛片。

掀开T恤下摆——左肋那块整片青紫，隔着皮肤都能看到底下淤血的轮廓。

碰一下就疼到发麻。

骨头大概没断，能动，但裂了至少一根。

他用绷带缠了几圈，勒紧，龇了一下牙。

接下来清点升级材料。

晶核和精钢板全摊在铺位上，系统弹出统计……

【基础晶核×19/变异晶核（蓝色）×1】

【精钢板×3（汽修间获取）】

【能源模块碎片×1（变异丧尸掉落）】

往边上一对，

【LV2升级需求：基础晶核×20，精钢板×5，能源模块×1（3碎片合成）】

差一颗基础晶核，差两块精钢板，差两块能源模块碎片。

方向有了，东西没凑齐，急也没用。

天黑透了。

服务区外面断断续续传来嘶吼，远的，不在系统警戒范围。

林昊把房车倒进主楼后厨，三面墙围着，只剩一个出入口。

他拖了两排翻倒的钢制货架横着堵死，每排少说四五百斤，普通丧尸推不动。

系统【基础警戒】常驻。

五十米内有移动体靠近，自动报警。

虽不算安全，但确是眼下能做到的极限了。

林昊缩在铺位上侧躺着，肋骨不允许平躺。

车厢的LED灯调到最暗一档，面板的蓝光映在车顶上，一晃一晃。

脑子停不下来。

女店员灰掉的眼珠，变异丧尸一拳碎水泥。

高速公路上站在车顶挥手的女人。

他踩着油门过去的，九十码，气流掀起她散乱的头发。

后视镜里那只手越来越小，越来越小，拐个弯就没了。

当时有一百个理由不停，三只丧尸位置不明、空间不够碾压、下车就是送命。

一百个理由，全对，全合理。

但凌晨三点瘫在铺位上的时候，一个都说服不了自己。

别想了，想也没用，事情已经过去了。

他翻开系统面板里一个之前没仔细看的图标，【末日百科】。

丧尸分类，目前记录三种。

普通丧尸：灰色标记，速度慢，怕火，头部弱点。

变异丧尸·力量型：橙色标记，表皮硬化，弱点后颈神经节。

第三条——锁着的。标题全是问号，颜色是红的。

红色，比橙色高一档。

不想看了。

他划到升级路线，找LV2房车的新增功能，两条…！

【太阳能辅助充电板】：日照条件下为车载电池充电，延长电子设备续航。

【基础净水系统】：将非饮用水源净化为安全饮用水，日净化量约20升。

两条命脉。

没电，系统面板和物资探测全是摆设。

没净水，瓶装水喝完就等死。

公路上的瓶装水不可能永远捡得到，但河水和雨水永远都有。

必须升到LV2。

他把面板关了。

在肋骨的钝痛里迷迷糊糊睡过去。

不知道过了多久。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lin Hao pulled out the anti-riot fork from the back of the mutated zombie's neck.

A strand of gray-black fascia hangs on the fork tines, and the fishy smell hits the nose.

He took two steps back and felt a burning pain in his left rib, and he didn't dare to take a deep breath.

The installation prompt for [External Storage Module] on the system panel flashed twice and then disappeared.

The number of storage space jumps from 5 to 8.2, which is three more cubic meters, which is enough.

He limped back to the supermarket shelves and moved the remaining cans into the car.

Luncheon meat, yellow peaches, compressed biscuits, mineral water.One trip to move one box, one trip to move one box.

On the way, I encountered two zombies coming from the direction of the kitchen in the corridor. I stabbed them to death one by one with a riot control fork.

Two more were blocked in the stairwell on the second floor, and four gray crystal cores were put into the pockets.

After moving the last box of water, my arms were shaking so much that I couldn't twist the bottle cap.

[Material inventory completed - food reserve: about 14 days/drinking water reserve: about 10 days]

[Melee weapons: riot fork × 1, rubber baton × 1, iron crowbar × 1]

[Long-range weapon: Hunting crossbow × 1 (12 crossbow arrows remaining)]

In the short term, you will never die of hunger or thirst.

Lin Hao leaned against the wall of the carriage and pulled out the first aid kit.Iodine, gauze, medical tape, no painkillers.

Lifting the hem of the T-shirt - the left rib was completely bruised, and the outline of bruises underneath could be seen through the skin.

It hurts to the point of numbness when touched.

The bones are probably not broken and can move, but at least one is cracked.

He wrapped the bandage several times, tightened it, and bared his teeth.

Next, inventory the upgrade materials.

The crystal cores and fine steel plates were all spread out on the bunk, and the system popped up statistics...

[Basic core × 19/mutated core (blue) × 1]

[Fine steel plate × 3 (obtained from the auto repair shop)]

[Energy module fragment × 1 (dropped by mutated zombies)]

A pair to the side,

[LV2 upgrade requirements: basic crystal core × 20, fine steel plate × 5, energy module × 1 (synthesized from 3 fragments)]

There is one basic crystal core missing, two fine steel plates missing, and two energy module fragments missing.

We have the direction, but we don’t have everything together, so there’s no point in rushing.

It was completely dark.

There were intermittent roars outside the service area. They were far away and were not within the system's warning range.

Lin Hao backed the RV into the back kitchen of the main building. It was surrounded by three walls and only had one entrance.

He dragged two rows of overturned steel shelves sideways to block them. Each row weighed at least four to five hundred kilograms, and ordinary zombies couldn't push them.

System [Basic Alert] is permanent.

If a moving object approaches within 50 meters, the alarm will automatically occur.

Although it is not safe, it is indeed the limit of what can be done at the moment.

Lin Hao huddled on the bunk and lay on his side, his ribs not allowing him to lie flat.

The LED lights in the car were turned to the dimmest setting, and the blue light from the panel reflected on the roof of the car, flickering.

My mind can't stop.

The female clerk's eyes turned gray, and the mutated zombie shattered the cement with one punch.

Woman waving from the roof of a car on the highway.

He stepped on the accelerator and passed, ninety yards away, and the air flow lifted her messy hair.

The hand in the rearview mirror became smaller and smaller, and disappeared after turning a corner.

There were a hundred reasons not to stop at that time. The location of the three zombies was unknown, there was not enough space to crush them, and if they got out of the car, they would die.

One hundred reasons, all correct and reasonable.

But when I was lying on the bunk at three o'clock in the morning, I couldn't convince myself.

Don't think about it, there's no point in thinking about it, it's over.

He opened an icon in the system panel that he had not looked at carefully before, [Doomsday Encyclopedia].

There are currently three types of zombie classifications recorded.

Ordinary zombies: gray mark, slow, afraid of fire, head weakness.

Mutated zombies·Strength type: Orange mark, epidermis sclerosis, weak point is the posterior cervical ganglion.

Article 3 - Locked.The title is all question marks and the color is red.

Red, one grade higher than orange.

I don’t want to read it.

He marked the upgrade route and looked for the new features of the LV2 RV, two...!

[Solar auxiliary charging board]: Charge the vehicle battery under sunlight conditions to extend the battery life of electronic devices.

[Basic water purification system]: Purify non-drinking water sources into safe drinking water, with a daily purification capacity of about 20 liters.

Two lifelines.

There is no power, and the system panel and material detection are all decorations.

Without purified water, you will die after drinking bottled water.

Bottled water will not always be available on the road, but river water and rain will always be available.

Must be upgraded to LV2.

He turned off the panel.

I drifted off to sleep with the dull pain in my ribs.

I don’t know how long it took.
